basic_info.description: Ultra-Urban Chic|Iconic SoHo-Style Loft steps from Fillmore St Shops/dining. Income producing property providing immense value!! Top Level at the 107 Wilmot entrance discover a rare architectural gem at the intersection of style, space, & location. Four blocks south of Alta Plaza & steps from the Fillmore Street shopping district, this light filled spacious 2-story loft is the ultimate live-work haven in San Francisco. 107 Wilmot/2232 Bush Street is 2 unit property with the residence above and restaurant below. It is a bold expression of creativity and versatility. Dramatic double-height ceilings across two full street-to-street levels, plus a sun-drenched third-floor pentroom that opens onto a spacious south-facing roof deck, this SoHo-style loft invites big ideas and even bigger living. Whether you're a visionary artist, a tech founder building the next unicorn, or a design-forward entertainer, this space adapts to your ambitions. Think: gallery-scale walls, open floor plans for dynamic work or social flow, + volume that inspires. Located below, on bustling Bush Street, is Mattina Restaurant & Cafe a celebrated Cal-Italian destination from James Beard Award-nominated chef Matthew Accarrino bringing exceptional cuisine to your doorstep in one of the best neighborhood.
